newsitem.title: USA: Reliv International to expand facilities.
newsitem.headline: Reliv International to expand facilities.

text.p: Reliv International Inc on Wednesday said it would begin expanding its headquarters and manufacturing facilities outside St. Louis this spring.

The company said the project would nearly triple its floor space to 136,000 square feet from 46,000 square feet. A Reliv spokesman said the timetable for completing the project had not been determined.
Reliv makes nutritional suppliments, diet management products and skin-care products.
Its shares were up 1/64 at 6-1/4 in early afternoon trading on the Nasdaq.
